2 Data

xeno <- qs_read(input$xeno)
genesets = getGmt(input$genesets)  %>% geneIds()
hif_targets =  scan(input$hif_targets, character(), quote = "")
genesets[["HIF_targets"]] = hif_targets
xeno_cell_usage = readRDS(input$xeno_cell_usage)
gep_scores = readRDS(input$gep_scores)
df = FetchData(xeno,vars = c("treatment","orig.ident"))

p = ggplot(df, aes(x = orig.ident, fill = treatment)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack") +
  labs(title = "Models data",
       x = "Model ID",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Treatment") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,size = 20),axis.title = element_text(size = 20),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),legend.text = element_text(size = 20),legend.title = element_text(size = 20),plot.title = element_text(size = 25))
p

5 Programs dotplot

# scale metagene and add to metadata
for (i  in 1:ncol(xeno_cell_usage)) {
  metagene_metadata = xeno_cell_usage[,i,drop=F] %>% scale()
  xeno = AddMetaData(object = xeno,metadata = metagene_metadata,col.name = paste0(names(xeno_cell_usage)[i],"_scaled"))
}
xeno = program_assignment(dataset = xeno,program_names = names(xeno_cell_usage),larger_by = 2)

p = programs_dotplot(seurat_obj = xeno,treatment_var = "treatment",program_names = names(xeno_cell_usage))

8 known genes signatures log TPM

gene_list = list(IFNa_genes = genesets$HALLMARK_INTERFERON_ALPHA_RESPONSE, TNFa_genes = genesets$HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB, hif_targets = hif_targets,E2F_genes = genesets$HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS)
patient_var = "orig.ident"
for (i in seq_along(gene_list)) {
  genes = gene_list[[i]]
  name = names(gene_list)[i]
  genes = genes[genes %in% rownames(xeno)]
  scores = FetchData(object = xeno,vars = c(genes,patient_var))
  scores = scores %>% mutate(r = rowMeans(dplyr::select_at(scores,vars(-contains(patient_var))))) %>% # z score every patient separately 
    group_by_at(patient_var) %>% plyr::summarise(r = scale(r)) %>% pull(r) %>% as.data.frame() 
  print(name)
  xeno %<>% AddMetaData(metadata = scores,col.name = name)
}
